canonical_project: Amazon Data Services Bauxite II / 3250 Digital Drive
aliases: Amazon Data Services Bauxite II / 3250 Digital Drive
status_as_of_cutoff: approved-permitted: Maryland issued Amazon Data Services, Inc. a final MDE air permit / permit-to-construct on March 25, 2026 for emergency backup generators serving BWI150-BWI153 at 3250 Digital Drive. The issued permit lists expected installation-to-operation dates in 2025-2026, but this air permit is not a building permit, certificate of occupancy, utility interconnection, PSC large-load registration, or proof of energized IT load. Current official sources reviewed on 2026-08-11 did not establish site work, energization, partial live status, or full buildout.
evidence_grade: A- official state permit and county policy records; physical stage and IT load remain unverified

actions.result_status: MDE final-determination materials state that Amazon Data Services' air-permit application for 3250 Digital Drive was received on October 29, 2024.
actions.access_caveat: Application receipt is not approval; the final permit PDF is a separate MDE document.
actions.evidence_note: Air application for emergency generators, not building approval.

actions.result_status: MDE approved and issued the final air-quality permit / permit-to-construct for Amazon Data Services at 3250 Digital Drive, covering BWI150-BWI153 and 99 diesel-fired emergency generators. The issued permit itemizes 92 Caterpillar 3516E 2,750-kW units, six Caterpillar C18 750-kW units, and one Caterpillar C9 250-kW unit, and lists expected installation-to-operation dates in 2025-2026.
actions.access_caveat: The news release announces the final decision; the issued permit PDF at https://mde.maryland.gov/datacenters/Documents/2026_AmazonDataServicesBWIIssuedPTC.pdf provides the control number, premises number, generator schedule, and owner/site details.
actions.evidence_note: Air permit for stationary emergency generators; not a building permit, CO, utility interconnection, or energization record.

actions.result_status: County announced a pause on accepting and processing new Critical Digital Infrastructure applications until December 31, 2026. The county data-center page states the pause does not apply to properties with development approvals before June 17, 2025 and does not stop work on projects currently under construction; it also requires proof of Maryland PSC large-load registry registration as a development-review condition.
actions.access_caveat: County policy page and news release summarize development-review rules; they are not project-specific building, occupancy, or energization records.
actions.evidence_note: Policy action, not construction, occupancy, or utility approval.

capacity_note: IT/electrical load capacity remains unverified from official records. The MDE air permit authorizes emergency backup generation totaling 257.75 MW nameplate, which should not be treated as data-center IT capacity.

official_records.title: MDE Frederick Data Center Sampling/Reports page
facts: MDE identifies the Amazon Data Services project as four buildings at 3250 Digital Drive within the Quantum Maryland / Quantum Frederick campus.
MDE links the 2026 Amazon Data Services BWI final air permit and final determination / response to comments.

official_records.title: Amazon Data Services BWI issued permit-to-construct
facts: Issued March 25, 2026; Control No. B-08076; premises no. 021-0809.
Site is Amazon Data Services, Inc. BWI-150 through BWI-153, 3250 Digital Drive, Frederick, MD 21703.
Authorizes 92 2,750-kW, six 750-kW, and one 250-kW diesel emergency generators, totaling 257.75 MW backup-generation nameplate.

official_records.title: MDE news release approving Amazon air permit
facts: MDE issued a final determination approving an air quality permit for Amazon Data Services at 3250 Digital Drive on March 25, 2026.
The permit restricts generators from primary-power use or demand-response participation.

official_records.title: Frederick County data centers policy page
facts: County is not accepting new data-center applications after the July 1, 2026 executive order through December 31, 2026.
County states the pause does not apply to properties with development approvals before June 17, 2025 and does not stop work on projects currently under construction.

official_records.title: Frederick County July 1, 2026 news release
facts: County announced the temporary pause and a separate order requiring proof of PSC large-load registry registration before advancing through county development review.
County restarted community-benefit negotiations related to the Quantum Frederick campus.
